proposal.status: Proposed by this corpus for the physical-observation and controller-outcome artifacts that Section 1.5 of the draft leaves undefined, from the failure model the draft fixes for them in Section 2 and Sections 8.2 to 8.4. Not the draft's text: every member that rests on one of these rules is ambiguous under -01.

provenance.author: hippoley (Noah Ellis)
provenance.note: The claim boundary and seven starting cases come from the proposal in issue 80. The FlyThink probes are cited, not copied: each member here was written for this corpus from the draft's text, and where a probe's expected answer rests on an artifact the draft leaves undefined the member is marked open and says so.

spec.author: T. Toraman
spec.status: Individual Internet-Draft, intended status Standards Track; not the agreed text of the SCITT working group, and a later revision can change it.

anchor.quote: A verifier evaluating a receipt -- alone or as part of a chain -- MUST NOT return a result whose named fields assert any of them on that basis, and where a consumer asked for one it MUST report that the receipt does not establish it.
